briefing.summary: As of Saturday August 8, 3:00 AM, satellite data for the Bald Range wildfire near Summerland, British Columbia, show 1250 detections over 10.2 hours. An evacuation order was reported by CBC for the entire District of Summerland from just after midnight on August 8, 2026. Estimated residents cut off range between 270 and 1080, depending on whether roads within 50 m or 100 m of a satellite detection are treated as impassable, affecting 278 road segments including Okanagan Highway, Bathville Road, Princeton-Summerland Road, Garnet Valley Road, and Prairie Valley Road.

caveats: These are illustrative estimates from public data including satellite fire detections, OpenStreetMap roads, and modelled population, not official guidance.
Drive times are estimated minimums with no congestion, showing an average sample of 14.1 minutes and a longest sample of 17.1 to 17.8 minutes for specific cut-off areas.
Official orders come first; follow instructions from local authorities.
Rely on the BC Wildfire Service, EmergencyInfoBC, and local evacuation orders for real decisions.
